messages:
hana_cs: Quick capture from today's duo calls — repeating asks on cost export + embeddings freshness. One account flagged as at-risk for renewal. Short buckets below, pls react.
leo_onboard: saw same in trial with GreenTide and Sable. Finance insisted on line-item export.
maria_prod: paste bullets + severity and I'll slot into intake. If renewal-risk, we P0.
hana_cs: asks:
1) finance-grade per-route export (high) — server-side CSV + API, columns: date, route, env, model_variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_usd, requests, avg_latency_ms. Filter by date range + tag. Brightlane called it a "must-have" (renewal in ~5w).
2) embeddings reindex scheduler (med-high) — TTL or cron-like job for streaming pipelines to avoid stale vectors.
3) burst/latency policy (med) — route-level toggle: latency-priority vs throughput, configurable hours.
wei_eng: Q: export needs exact billing parity or documented daily aggregates? Also do we want UI export only or API first?
hana_cs: customers want authoritative numbers for finance reconciliation. Daily batch is fine; both UI export + API preferred.
maria_prod: proposed triage -> P0: per-route export for accounts with renewals <8w; P1: embeddings scheduler; P2: burst policy + onboarding snippets. Will validate in triage by impact x confidence.
leo_onboard: I'll tag existing tickets with `feedback:per-route-export` and add call notes to the GH triage issue.
sync_bot: Reminder: CS/Product weekly sync in 48h at 10:00 PT  Agenda: renewal signals. Thread auto-added.
wei_eng: I'll sketch a minimal export schema and post a sample CSV by EOD. If ok, we can prototype a daily aggregator job.
hana_cs: marking Brightlane high-risk in renewal tracker and adding this thread to the sync agenda. Thanks all. :pray:
